Domain Applied ML/ PET Core team
LLM PEFT enables efficient training and inference on Gemini LLMs/LMMs within Google.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ECI rotation program
Team 1: Dataflow team
- Create the lazy loading feature for Debug Capture Monitor to speed up the initial loading time of Cloud internal debugging tools.
Team 2: Borglet
- Work in Borg infrastructure
- Deliver Riptide for virtual cloud machine

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
+ Manage financial aspects of Copart’s business in the US and UK as a part of the back-office team, raised personal KPIs by 50% after the first 3 weeks.
+ Solved 20+ existed bugs/new stories of the project in the first 2 months. Slashed time to test by 30%.
+ Prepared and submitted work reports and other documentation to assist development team members.
+ Language/Technology: Java, Spring (Spring Core Annotations for dependency injection and Spring MVC for Rest APIs), Jenkins, Spinnaker, Git, Jira, Confluence

positions.title: Research Assistant - Cyber Network and Security
positions.locationName: 2800 S University Dr, Fort Worth, TX 76129
positions.description:
+ Provided assistance to circa 20 computer science students in labs and in-class materials. Supported creating lab lectures for the class and created 2 new labs for professors to teach in class (WPS and WPA attack). Conducted data collection and analysis methodologies/techniques. Developed computational solutions to a wide range of applications
+ Utilized several platforms/technologies including Fedora, Ubuntu/Reaver, Pixiewps, Aircrack, and WireShark.
+ Gained knowledge of analyze a system and conduct a security analysis of system implementation. 
+ Influenced decision-making by searching for fundamental results and insights.

honors.title: ACM-ICPC 2019 South Central USA Regional Contest Bronze Medalist
honors.description:
- Solved 6/12 Problems
- Ranked 12/60 Overall
- Ranked 1/19 Undergraduate Program
honors.issuer: Issued by ICPC North America · Nov 2019

projects.title: Covid Tracker
projects.description:
+ Created a user-friendliness and reliability Covid Tracker API to provide accurate and timely information
+ Created 3 different versions of FrontEnd API using HTML, Vue, and React to make a general FrontEnd API for public use
+ Created BackEnd API using Spring Boot, Java, and MongoDB then ran it on AWS server
+ Language/Technology used: Java, Javascript, Python, HTML, CSS, Vue, Vuetify, React, Material-UI, Spring Boot, Apache tomcat, D3, Leaflet, MongoDB, AWS

projects.title: SuperFrog Scheduler
projects.description:
+ Created a user-friendliness and reliability Scheduler API help manage and schedule appointments/events
+ Created FrontEnd API using BootStrap and Thymeleaf and BackEnd API using Spring Boot, Java, and MySQL then ran it on Heroku server
+ Language/Technology used: Java, Javascript, HTML, CSS, Thymeleaf, Bootstrap, Spring Boot, H2-Console, MySQL, Heroku
